findings.citation_text: Interference between a camera CFA and a high-frequency grid background enables ultra-precise pose estimation and tracking [19–21]. MoiréPose targets 6-DoF localization [19], and MoiréVision extends this concept to curvilinear patterns with sub-pixel feature extraction [20]. MoiréVib demodulates periodic fringe motion for micro-vibration sensing [21].
findings.reasoning: This context is in the Related Work section, where MoiréPose [19] is listed as an existing work using Moiré patterns for pose estimation. It is presented as a representative example of the 'single high-frequency grid × camera CFA' approach, without evaluation or extension.

findings.citation_text: Moiré patterns have been used in visual sensing because small geometric displacements yield large, measurable phase shifts in the fringes [5, 19–22, 33, 36, 37].
